purpose: Positive/negative control for the official Deep LLM title judge. A judge validated only on 0-hit items cannot be distinguished from an always-no-match bug; this control closes that gap.
scorer_source: scripts/run_deep_official_scoring.py (prompts/model/temperature/parser extracted at runtime, never transcribed)
interpretation: The judge says yes on verbatim, truncated, and case/punctuation-variant matches of the same paper, and no on different papers. Combined with the scored run, hits and zero-hits are both observable outcomes of a functioning judge.
